title: Battle for Jets' backup QB job is Cade Klubnik's to lose after surprise preseason start

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Battle for Jets' backup QB job is Cade Klubnik's to lose after surprise preseason start
sources.description: After being thrust into the starting role for Friday's preseason opener against the Bucs, Cade Klubnik showed enough poise and control with the offense that the Jets' backup QB job should be his.
